reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount helpers and the balance handling extends the Akahu branch, but the download is a new per-provider function rather than a shared one.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error mapping, response shaping), adding one more copy to an already duplicated family.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and the type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Only the edits needed for the new provider; no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: Follows the established provider pattern and the shared link path; the copied download function is the main maintenance cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Link uses linkBankSyncAccount/assertBankAccountNotLinked; no existing shared download abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is an open, undisguised copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.
